question: A plane electromagnetic wave is travelling along the positive $x$-direction. If the electric field is along the positive $y$-direction, determine the direction of the magnetic field. Justify your answer.

options.A: The magnetic field is along $-\hat{k}$ because $\hat{j}\times(-\hat{k})=-\hat{i}$.
options.B: The magnetic field is along $+\hat{j}$ because it must be parallel to the electric field.
options.C: The magnetic field is along $-\hat{i}$ because the wave travels along $+\hat{i}$.
options.D: The propagation direction is $\vec{E}\times\vec{B}$. With $\vec{E}$ along $+\hat{j}$ and propagation along $+\hat{i}$, $\vec{B}$ must be along $+\hat{k}$ since $\hat{j}\times\hat{k}=\hat{i}$.
